title: replace and createFile remove their temporary file when a write fails
summary: @inventarch/distribution's replace and createFile (the publishers `ia author` writes through) now remove their temporary sibling file when opening it succeeds and the permission change, the write or the fsync then fails, as they already did when the rename or link failed; before, such a failure left a `<target>.<uuid>.tmp` file beside the target. The published file, its permission bits and the IA-DIST-LOCAL-MODIFICATION refusal for an entry that appeared are unchanged. Limits: neither publisher locks its target, so a writer that saves the file between a caller's last read and the rename is still replaced; a caller narrows that window by reading the file through an opened handle just before, as ia author does, but cannot close it.
